2609.29428.title: agentic-ger: terminology recovery in long-form speech using global context
2609.29428.paper_summary: Recent advances in speech language models have improved automatic speech recognition (ASR) for long-form audio. However, accurately and consistently transcribing domain-specific terminology remains challenging. Motivated by the world knowledge and contextual capability of large language models (LLMs), we propose Agentic-GER, an LLM-based agent for terminology correction in long-form speech. The agent uses global context from the full transcript to identify suspicious terms and resolve ambiguous hypotheses. It selectively re-transcribes the source speech to check candidate corrections, and uses accepted edits to guide subsequent decisions. Experiments with four LLMs and two ASR systems on GigaSpeechBench show consistent terminology improvements in both Chinese and English, with and without thinking. On Chinese speech, Agentic-GER achieves up to a 36.8% relative reduction in biased character error rate (B-CER) over the Whisper baseline.
2609.29428.paper_summary_zh: 最近在語音語言模型方面的進展改善了長格式音頻的自動語音識別（ASR）。<lb/>然而，準確且一致地轉錄特定領域的術語仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>受到大型語言模型（LLMs）在世界知識和上下文能力方面的啟發，我們提出了Agentic-GER，一種基於LLM的術語修正代理，用於長格式語音。<lb/>該代理使用完整轉錄的全球上下文來識別可疑術語並解決模糊的假設。<lb/>它有選擇性地重新轉錄源語音以檢查候選修正，並使用接受的編輯來指導後續決策。<lb/>在GigaSpeechBench上對四個LLM和兩個ASR系統的實驗顯示，在中文和英文中，無論是否進行思考，術語都有一致的改善。<lb/>在中文語音中，Agentic-GER在偏見字符錯誤率（B-CER）上相對於Whisper基準實現了高達36.8%的減少。
